description: This PHP source file defines the RgbTint class, which handles the application of tint effects to colors, especially in the context of Excel styling. It includes methods for color space conversions (RGB to HLS and back), tint calculations, and color formatting.

classes.name: RgbTint
classes.description: Handles tint applied to colors, including conversions between RGB and HLS color spaces and applying tint effects based on Excel's formulas.

methods.name: rgbToHls
methods.description: Converts RGB values to HLS (Hue, Luminance, Saturation).

methods.name: hlsToRgb
methods.description: Converts HLS values back to RGB.

methods.name: vFunction
methods.description: Helper function used in RGB to HLS conversion and vice versa, based on hue position.

methods.name: positiveDecimalPart
methods.description: Ensures hue values are within the [0,1) range.

methods.name: rgbToMsHls
methods.description: Converts RGB to HLS using HLSMAX scale (used in Excel).

methods.name: msHlsToRgb
methods.description: Converts HLS from HLSMAX scale back to RGB.

methods.name: tintLuminance
methods.description: Calculates luminance after applying tint, based on Excel formulas.

methods.name: rgbAndTintToRgb
methods.description: Main method to apply tint to an RGB color and return the resulting color as a hex string.
